title: AE40018: Introduction To Turbulence
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Nature and origin of turbulence; Reynolds averaging, Boussinesq eddy viscosity
hypothesis, Prandtl s mixing length theory and von Karman s similarity
hypothesis, vorticity dynamics; Statistical theory of turbulence: isotropic and
homogeneous turbulence, scales of turbulence, turbulence modeling: turbulent
boundary layers, wakes jets and mixing layers, LES and DNS, experimental
methods in turbulence, turbulent flow in pipes.
